landscape.label: 2026 Price Guide
landscape.kicker: For window tinting & window film companies
title: Window Film SEO
& Marketing Prices
landscape.say: How much does SEO and marketing cost for a window film company in 2026? Here's the pricing guide: the four price tiers agencies charge, what you get at each level, what moves your price, and the questions to ask before you sign.

landscape.label: 2026 Price Tiers
landscape.title: What window film SEO costs per month
landscape.sub: 2026 monthly ranges · depending on your market and scope
landscape.speak: Most window film companies land in one of four tiers. A starter plan runs about three hundred to five hundred dollars a month. A growth plan runs five hundred to one thousand dollars a month. A multi-city plan runs one thousand to two thousand dollars a month. And in a competitive market, expect two thousand to five thousand dollars a month.
landscape.say: Most window film companies land in one of four tiers. A starter plan runs about $300 to $500 a month. A growth plan runs $500 to $1,000 a month. A multi-city plan runs $1,000 to $2,000 a month. And in a competitive market, expect $2,000 to $5,000 a month.

landscape.label: Tier 1 of 4
landscape.name: Starter
landscape.desc: The foundation: get found on Google Maps.

bullets.t: Best for one location in a smaller market

landscape.speak: The starter tier, three hundred to five hundred dollars a month, is the foundation. You get Google Business Profile management: the right categories, services, photos, and posts, so you show up on Google Maps. Plus some on-site optimization of your website. It's best for one location in a smaller market.
landscape.say: The starter tier, $300 to $500 a month, is the foundation. You get Google Business Profile management: the right categories, services, photos, and posts, so you show up on Google Maps. Plus some on-site optimization of your website. It's best for one location in a smaller market.

landscape.label: Tier 2 of 4
landscape.name: Growth

bullets.t: Citations: Yelp, Apple Maps, Bing & directories

landscape.speak: The growth tier, five hundred to one thousand dollars a month, includes everything in the starter plan, plus citations, so your business name, address, and phone match on Yelp, Apple Maps, Bing, and the directories. You also get analytics reporting, and some backlinks.
landscape.say: The growth tier, $500 to $1,000 a month, includes everything in the starter plan, plus citations, so your business name, address, and phone match on Yelp, Apple Maps, Bing, and the directories. You also get analytics reporting, and some backlinks.

landscape.label: Tier 3 of 4
landscape.name: Multi-city
landscape.desc: More of everything, for more cities and film types.

bullets.t: A page for every film type & service city
Review system that names the film
Monthly reports on calls & estimate requests

landscape.speak: The multi-city tier, one thousand to two thousand dollars a month, is more of everything. You get a page for every film type and every city you serve, steady citations and backlinks each month, a system to get reviews that name the film you installed, and monthly reports on calls and estimate requests.
landscape.say: The multi-city tier, $1,000 to $2,000 a month, is more of everything. You get a page for every film type and every city you serve, steady citations and backlinks each month, a system to get reviews that name the film you installed, and monthly reports on calls and estimate requests.

landscape.label: Tier 4 of 4
landscape.name: Competitive market
landscape.desc: For big, crowded markets where every map spot is a fight.
landscape.speak: And the competitive market tier, two thousand to five thousand dollars a month, is for big, crowded markets, where every spot on the map is a fight. You get aggressive backlink building, citations everywhere buyers look, custom reporting by booked job, and lead generation.
landscape.say: And the competitive market tier, $2,000 to $5,000 a month, is for big, crowded markets, where every spot on the map is a fight. You get aggressive backlink building, citations everywhere buyers look, custom reporting by booked job, and lead generation.

landscape.label: Industry Benchmarks
landscape.title: What SEO costs across all industries
landscape.note: Source: SEO.com, How Much Does SEO Cost? (2026)
landscape.speak: How does that compare? According to SEO dot com, local SEO across all industries runs five hundred to twenty-five hundred dollars a month, and traditional SEO runs fifteen hundred to five thousand dollars a month. Hourly SEO work is seventy-five to two hundred dollars an hour, and one-time projects run one thousand to thirty thousand dollars.
landscape.say: How does that compare? According to SEO.com, local SEO across all industries runs $500 to $2,500 a month, and traditional SEO runs $1,500 to $5,000 a month. Hourly SEO work is $75 to $200 an hour, and one-time projects run $1,000 to $30,000.

landscape.label: What Moves Your Price
landscape.title: What moves your price

cards.name: Your market
cards.desc: A big metro costs more than a small town

cards.name: Cities you serve
cards.desc: Every city needs its own pages & listings

cards.name: Website health
cards.desc: A slow, broken site costs more to fix

cards.name: AI search
cards.desc: ChatGPT & AI Overviews: often its own line item

landscape.say: What moves your price? Your market: a big metro costs more than a small town. How many cities you serve. Which film types you sell, from residential and commercial to security, decorative, and auto. Your website's health. AI search, which is often its own line item. And whether you add video and social media.

landscape.label: Is It Worth It?
landscape.title: Is it worth it?

tiles.s: A single lead can pay for a year of SEO
The top 3 on Google Maps get the calls
Profile fixes can help within weeks

landscape.speak: Is it worth it? A single commercial window film lead can be a twenty thousand dollar job, which can pay for a year of SEO. The top three on Google Maps get the calls. And while profile fixes can help within weeks, rankings usually build over three to six months.

landscape.label: Before You Sign
landscape.title: 6 questions to ask before you sign
items: Does it cover AI search like ChatGPT?
Do reports show calls & booked jobs?
Do I own my site & listings?
Do you work with my competitors?
landscape.note: Compare quotes on the same deliverables, not just the price.
landscape.say: Before you sign, ask six questions. Does it cover AI search like ChatGPT? Is software billed on top? Do reports show calls and booked jobs? Is it month-to-month? Do I own my site and listings? And do you work with my competitors? Then compare quotes on the same deliverables, not just the price.
